2022_244_8_e_troy_high_unox_replacement_.paragraph: Agenda item 8.E. for the Troy School District Board of Education meeting of April 19, 2022 consists of a dated 04/04/2022 equipment quote from Stafford Smith, Inc., 25311 Dequindre Road, Madison Heights, MI 48071, for the Troy High Unox Replacement 2022 Project under Job Reference Number 4965. The quote prices replacement UNOX ChefTop MIND.Maps Plus gas countertop combi ovens in left-hand door (XAVC-06FS-GPLM) and right-hand door (XAVC-06FS-GPRM) configurations, together with UNOX Long.Life4 extended warranties, stacking kits, water filtration, certified installation, and Krowne gas connector hose kits. After trade-in credits for existing 2014 units, the Project Grand Total is $86,526.00.

Warranty and installation
Standard coverage is 2 year parts and 1 year labor. UNOX Long.Life4 provides a 4yr/10,000 ON hours parts and 1 yr labor warranty, requires the oven to be connected to the internet by Ethernet or WIFI within 30 days of installation and remain accessible for remote login by UNOX, and includes a pre-installation site inspection, assembly, setting and leveling, and final hook-up by a Certified UNOX Service Agent. Pricing is based on a 50 mile radius from the installer (100 miles round trip, two trips). Site inspection and installation requests must be received at least ten (10) business days before the desired service date. Code does not allow re-use of existing gas hoses; the District is to add a second gas connection behind each oven. Existing Pure filters are to be re-used for one of the ovens in each stack, with (2) double stack ovens.

Commercial terms
Surcharges from supply chain and freight cost increases after order placement are passed to the customer. Past due amounts carry service charges of 1 1/2% per month plus collection costs and attorney fees. Stafford-Smith retains a security interest until paid in full; disputes fall under the State of Michigan and County of Kalamazoo. The proposal excludes State and Federal taxes, electrical wiring and plumbing, and is subject to acceptance within thirty (30) days of the quote date. Freight damage claims must be filed within (48) hours. Effective 2-1-22 a 3.5% surcharge applies to credit card transactions; ACH, ECheck and wire are accepted alternatives.
2022_244_8_e_troy_high_unox_replacement_.verbose:
Agenda item 8.E. for the Troy School District Board of Education meeting of April 19, 2022, titled Troy High Unox Replacement 2022 Project, is a vendor quote dated 04/04/2022 from Stafford Smith, Inc., 25311 Dequindre Road, Madison Heights, MI 48071, telephone 248-798-9114, with Matthew Bigelow named as the Stafford Smith contact. The quote carries Job Reference Number 4965 and runs six numbered quote pages (Page 1 of 6 through Page 6 of 6) with initial lines on each, followed by UNOX manufacturer specification sheets, an install form, and a certified installation program document, paginated by Stafford Smith through Page: 15.

SCOPE AND UNITS BEING REPLACED
The quote identifies four existing ovens by serial number: Troy High Unox Replacement - Oven One - Serial# 2013G0043439; Troy High Unox Replacement - Oven Two - Serial # 201300014600; Troy Athens Unox Replacement - Oven One - Serial # 2014-E0032160; Troy Athens Unox Replacement - Oven Two - Serial # 2014-J0060743.

ITEM 1 - UNOX MODEL XAVC-06FS-GPLM
Described as a ChefTop MIND.Maps Plus Combi Oven, gas, countertop, (6) 18" x 26" full size sheet or (12) hotel size pan capacity, MIND.Maps technology, programmable menu, 2-11/16" shelf spacing, glass door, left-to-right door opening, stainless steel interior and exterior, WIFI/USB for data transfer to HACCP software, 1kW, 8 amps, 120v/60/1-ph, cETLus, NSF, ENERGY STAR, with a cooking chamber built from 316L stainless steel. A safety note states that CHEFTOP MIND.Maps gas ovens, free standing and countertop models, must be equipped with only UNOX brand casters with safety chains. Line detail: 4 ea COMBI OVEN, GAS at a sell of $12,916.00 for a total of $51,664.00; 1 ea INSTALL FORM End User Data & Installation Confirmation Form; 4 ea 2 Year parts and 1 year labor warranty standard; 1 ea UNOX.LONG LIFE4 extended warranty with certified installation at $1,424.00 (sell $1,424.00, first unit, noted 1011, 06FS, 10FS); 3 ea UNOX.LONG LIFE4 for 2nd or more unit(s) installed at the same time and location as the 1st unit at a sell of $1,205.00 for $3,615.00 (NET); 4 ea Natural gas; 2 ea XAAQC-00E2-G Stacking Kit for ChefTop MIND.Maps Plus, including installation kits and stacking parts for stacking two ovens, for gas ovens including floor stand (XWARC-00-EF-F) and casters (XUC012), sell $1,150.00 for $2,300.00; 2 ea Stacked unit installation, which must be purchased with the corresponding unit and LONG.Life4, sell $219.00 for $438.00 (NET); 2 ea XHC012 UNOX.Finest Filtering System, which reduces carbonate hardness of water with ChefTouch monitoring of water consumption and cartridge replacement notification, sell $291.00 for $582.00; 2 ea Water Filter installation, sell $192.00 for $384.00; a second pair of 2 ea XHC012 UNOX.Finest Filtering System at sell $290.00 for $580.00; and 2 ea Water Filter installation at sell $192.00 for $384.00. Notes state that existing Pure filters are re-used for one of the ovens in each of the stacks, with (2) double stack ovens, and that water filter installation can only be purchased when the Water Filtration is also purchased from UNOX. A 1 ea TRADE IN Discount for trade in of 2 existing 2014 units at this school is shown at $-13,480.00. ITEM TOTAL: $47,891.00. A sub-line, Item 1.1, 4 ea CUSTOM, is shown at a sell of $-1,500.00 for $-6,000.00, with ITEM TOTAL: $-6,000.00; the accompanying Stafford-Smith note concerns ENERGY STAR REBATE IF APPLICABLE, advising that some food service equipment is Energy Star rated and can qualify for substantial rebates from the local utility provider, a program subject to change without notice.

ITEM 2 - UNOX MODEL XAVC-06FS-GPRM
Same ChefTop MIND.Maps Plus Combi Oven configuration but with right-to-left door opening, and with the note that gas lines are not included with the oven and must be purchased separately. Line detail: 4 ea COMBI OVEN, GAS at a sell of $12,532.00 for a total of $50,128.00; 1 ea UNOX.LONG LIFE4 extended warranty with certified installation at $1,424.00; 3 ea UNOX.LONG LIFE4 for additional units at sell $1,205.00 for $3,615.00; 2 ea XAAQC-00E2-G Stacking Kit at sell $1,150.00 for $2,300.00; 2 ea Stacked unit installation at sell $219.00 for $438.00; 2 ea XHC012 UNOX.Finest Filtering System at sell $291.00 for $582.00; 2 ea Water Filter installation at sell $192.00 for $384.00; and 1 ea TRADE IN Discount for trade in of 2 existing 2014 units at this school at $-13,080.00. ITEM TOTAL: $45,791.00. Item 2.1, 4 ea CUSTOM, is shown at sell $-1,500.00 for $-6,000.00, with ITEM TOTAL: $-6,000.00, again alongside the ENERGY STAR rebate note.

ITEM 3 - KROWNE MODEL M7548K10
Royal Series Moveable Gas Connection Kit, 3/4" I.D., 48" long, stainless steel corrugated tubing and radial wrap with green antimicrobial PVC coating, (1) quick disconnect, (2) 360 degree swivel, (1) full port valve, (2) 90 degree elbows, restraining cable with mounting hardware, 180K BTU/hr minimum flow capacity. Notes state that code does not allow for re-use of existing gas hoses, that the District is to add a second gas connection behind each oven, and that these items ship UPS or Fed Ex ground, FOB factory. Line detail: 8 ea GAS CONNECTOR HOSE KIT / ASSEMBLY at a sell of $293.00 for $2,344.00. ITEM TOTAL: $2,344.00.

QUOTE TOTALS
Merchandise $84,026.00; Freight $2,500.00; Subtotal $86,526.00; Total $86,526.00. The signature page repeats Project Grand Total: $86,526.00 above blanks for Acceptance, Date, and Printed Name.

WARRANTY, INSTALLATION AND UNOX LONG.LIFE4
Standard coverage is 2 year parts and 1 year labor. Pricing is based on a 50 mile radius from the installer, with additional charges possible. The UNOX Long.Life4 program provides an extended warranty of 4yr/10,000 ON hours parts and 1 yr labor; the oven must be connected to the internet via Ethernet cable or WIFI and remain accessible for remote login by UNOX, with connection required within 30 days of installation. Long.Life4 also includes a pre-installation site inspection by an UNOX Certified Service Agent, follow-up instructions on additional material needed for site preparation, assembly, setting and leveling of the equipment, and final hook-up by a Certified UNOX Service Agent. The install form advises that site inspection and installation requests must be received at least ten (10) business days prior to the desired date of service, that all UNOX equipment must be installed by qualified appliance installers, and that all gas powered UNOX ovens require calibration at the installation site by a qualified gas technician using a gas combustion analyzer, performed by the UNOX installer at the time of installation. Declining Long.Life4 means UNOX will not warranty service calls related to improper installation and the customer is responsible for calibration. The UNOX Certified Installation Program covers travel within a 50-mile radius (100 miles round trip) of the UNOX approved installer for two trips, pre-installation site inspection, assembly of unit and accessories, placement and leveling, connection to utilities within 3 feet of final placement, mechanical/electrical start up and calibration, and an operational/functional test. Standard pricing excludes overtime travel or labor, additional installer visits, delivery of equipment (the unit must be within 5 feet with a clear, unobstructed path), removal of packing material or old equipment, special licensing or permits, water testing, and gas line or power cable for electric units. Installation environment requirements include temperatures between 41 degrees F and 104 degrees F, maximum humidity of 70%, at least 2 inches clearance on all sides, a minimum of 18 inches from any external heat source on the sides and 27 1/2 inches to the rear or an adequate heat shield, and full access to the rear of the unit. Drain requirements cite a 1 1/8" diameter discharge pipe and a floor drain or high temp drain line with a 2 1/2" cup allowing a 1" air gap within 3 feet of unit placement. UNOX, Inc. is located at 987 Airlie Parkway, Denver, NC 28037, phone (800) 489-8669 / 1-800-489-UNOX, orders to orders.usa@unox.com; the install form is coded R210507SO.

MANUFACTURER SPECIFICATIONS
The XAVC-06FS-GPLM sheet (revision dated 12/17/2020) lists Width 33-7/8" (860 mm), Depth 38-1/16" (967 mm), Height 33-1/8" (842 mm), Net Weight 287 lbs (130 kg), Pan spacing 3-1/8" (80 mm), a 9.5" touch control panel, hinged right (left hand door), 1000+ programs, MULTI.TIME management of up to 10 cooking processes, temperature range 86 degrees F to 500 degrees F, up to 9 cooking steps, CLIMA.Control humidity or dry air set by 10%, and a cooking chamber in AISI 304 stainless steel with rounded edges. Power and gas supply: Voltage 120 V, Phase ~1PH+N+PE, Frequency 60 Hz, Total power 1 kW, Maximum Amp Draw 8 A, Required breaker size 10 A, Power cable requirement SJTO 3 3, Cord diameter 10 mm, Plug NEMA 5-20P. Water supply is a 3/4" NPT drinking water inlet at line pressure 22 to 87 psi; 1.5 to 6 Bar (29 psi; 2 Bar recommended), with inflow specifications of free chlorine no more than 0.1 ppm, chloramine no more than 0.1 ppm, TDS no more than 125 ppm, pH 7 - 8.5, electrical conductivity no more than 1000 microsiemens/cm; steam circuit total hardness no more than 8 degrees dH (142 ppm) and chlorides no more than 25 ppm; wash circuit total hardness no more than 30 degrees dH (534 ppm) and chlorides no more than 120 ppm. Connection positions listed include 12 hot fumes exhaust chimney, 11 cavity drain pipe, 10 Rotor.KLEAN connection, 9 3/4" gas inlet, 8 3/4" thread water inlet, 7 safety thermostat, 6 technical data plate, 3 unipotential terminal, 2 terminal board power supply, 30 combustion gasses exhaust, 27 cooling air outlet, and 13 accessories connection.

The XAVC-06FS-GPRM sheet (revision dated 4/26/2021) describes the same 6 tray 18"x26" gas combi steamer with the hinge on the left side (right hand door) and a cooking chamber in AISI 316L stainless steel, with Width 860 mm, Depth 967 mm, Height 842 mm (also given as 33-7/8", 38-1/16", 33-1/8"), Net Weight 287 lbs / 130 kg, and tray pitch 80 mm (3-1/8"). Power and gas supply: Voltage 120 V, Phase ~1PH+N+PE, Frequency 60 Hz, Total power 1 kW, Maximum Amp Draw 8 A, Required breaker size 15 A, Power cable requirements 3 x AWG 14, Cord size 0.39 in, Plug NEMA 5-20P. Gas data: nominal gas power 81892 BTU/h for both NG and LPG; NG inlet pressure minimum 3.5 i.w.c. and maximum 10.5 i.w.c.; LPG minimum 8.0 i.w.c. and maximum 13.0 i.w.c.; gas valve orifice 2-11/64" for LPG; gas hook-up 3/4" female NPT; fully integrated drain cooling valve with drain discharge temperature no more than 140 degrees F. A UNOX dimensions and power table in the installation document lists, among other models, XAVC-06FS-GP* at 33 7/8" wide, 37 11/16" deep, 33 1/4" high, 254 lbs, 120V 1PH, 15 A, 14 AWG / NEMA 5-20P, alongside electric variants such as XAVC-06FS-EP* (220 lbs, 208-240V 3PH, 60 A, 6 AWG / 4 Wire), XAVC-06FS-HP* (236 lbs, 440-480V 3PH, 35 A, 10 AWG / 4 Wire), XAVC-10FS-GP* (335 lbs) and XAVC-16FS-GP* (485 lbs, 25 A).

COMMERCIAL TERMS
Stafford Smith states it is not responsible for unforeseen surcharges, price increases, and other cost increases after the order is placed due to global supply chain and freight issues, and that such costs will be passed along to the customer with proof surrendered upon request. Terms provide that upon receipt of an application for a business account, signed quote/purchase order, and credit department review, the down payment and terms will be established; Stafford-Smith reserves the right to progress bill for equipment, including items shipped by the manufacturer to Stafford-Smith for storage, not conditional on installation or connection. Stafford-Smith retains a security interest in all equipment, parts, small wares, accessories, attachments, additions and replacements until all amounts are paid, and the buyer authorizes filing of a financing statement. Past due amounts constitute a default and are subject to service charges of 1 1/2% per month, collection costs, and attorney fees, and warranties are conditioned on payment of the full purchase price. In the event of default, Stafford-Smith may take possession of collateral under the Uniform Commercial Code; the buyer submits to jurisdiction in the State of Michigan and County of Kalamazoo. The proposal excludes applicable State or Federal taxes and any charge for electrical wiring or plumbing, and is subject to acceptance by buyer and seller within thirty (30) days from the date of the quote. Drop-ship inspection terms allow a driver to be asked to wait, require noting damage or marking the receipt "driver not willing to wait," and require notice to Stafford-Smith within (48) hours for a claim to be filed, with original cartons retained. Effective 2-1-22 a 3.5% surcharge applies to credit card transactions, with ACH, ECheck and wire accepted as alternatives payable through the Stafford-Smith website.
